gaps: sound.engine/engine_end/exhaust/move/rotate_turret: per-unit {on "add_movement_sound"} block in set/interaction_entity/tank.inc|car.inc keyed "<id> tank"; a clone matches no block and is silent or generic. New op: sound {entity, like, set{engine:..}} = copy the like's "<like> tank" block under "<id> tank" into a mod include of entity.set
effects.burn_by_engine and other per-unit interaction blocks (same "<id> tank" block): covered by the same sound op if it copies the whole block (name it iblock)

crew.macro, seat_human, crew_human, gunner_visible, board_animation, wheel, tank_trace/car_trace (marks, scroller), locomotion preset, abm_* presets, resupply macros, selection include scale: macro call args. gen armor edits only armor_* calls. New op: macro {entity, macro, arg, value | add | remove} = opArmor generalised to any ("name" args) call
card.limit: needs a unique card tag plus a unitLimits entry in every preset. New op: preset {file, name|all, set{unitLimits|chargeFactors|commandPoints: "tag=N"}} (append, ; separated)

card.price_coop / card.price_sp: no tool writes units/cooperative.set or a <gameType>.set copy. New op: card {unit, army, fields, list: cooperative|<gameType>} that creates the list file as an include of common.set content plus the override card
card.not_for_sale / card.basic / card.remove / card.icon: card op only replaces fields that exist. Extend card op: flags [not_for_sale, basic, remove] and add-missing-field
bots.* for a roster op: roster only prints advice; /api/x/units/add copies rows. Extend gen roster with bots: true|<priority> like squad
selection.include and selection.scale: include line args, same macro op (target the include call)
wreck.x clone: /api/x/units/add clones only _xx. Extend gen clone {wreck: true} to clone <like>_x and <like>_xx together
text.info / text.special / text.armor_angle: gen text writes any key, but no recipe step names these keys; recipe only
card.wait_first is derived; recipe asks it and compiles to fore (balance route already does this)
notes: counts = vanilla vehicle defs (349 unit defs, 659 wreck defs under /x/) using the key after macros and includes; own-file use is lower for inherited keys. Census from the as64 install read through tools/lib/vfs + sdlx, 2026-11-12.
